spec.name: Tan-Tan Moussem
spec.description: Annual gathering of Saharan nomadic tribes in Tan-Tan, featuring camel markets, tbourida, Hassani poetry and music, traditional games and crafts. Proclaimed by UNESCO a Masterpiece of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity and inscribed on the Representative List in 2008.

recurrence.note: Originally tied to the seasonal gathering of nomadic tribes; modern editions are usually held in May or June
